scope: Verified cited clauses against locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 with errata collection 3. Cubic boundary conditions, recovery choices, and transfer coverage are explicit project policies. Independent rational interpolation and standard-library encoders supply expectations.

requirements.rule: Order 3 uses a local interpolating cubic spline. Boundary conditions are project policy: centred interior tangents and one-sided endpoint tangents preserve samples and affine functions. Applying the fewer-than-four-samples linear fallback independently per axis is the project reading of 7.10.2. Decode and Range are applied after interpolation.

Empty text and unsigned signature widgets paint only their specified MK background and border. Field types and values inherit through Parent; null means absent. Nonempty values remain explicit unsupported appearances. Rotated backgrounds are invariant; rotated borders remain unsupported. Rotation must be a multiple of 90 degrees.
requirements.gaps: The unchanged rotated-widget-border input now has an independent literal-strip oracle; standalone no-AcroForm value inheritance retains its original annotation.appearance refusal.

requirements.rule: Final device transfers are selected by the topmost elementary intrinsic shape. Only opaque elementary objects and opaque ancestor invocations retain their specified transfer. Transparent objects select the device default Identity. Group objects and soft-mask artwork do not select transfers. Nonlinear evaluation uses f64. Fractional boundaries involving nondefault transfers, pattern selection and per-colourant selection remain unsupported. An array of four Identity names is the default transfer, even through indirect references. Pattern and overprint artwork in a soft mask does not select page transfers. Transfers used only in tiling-pattern cells are detected and rejected explicitly until pattern-region selection is implemented.

Repairs retain a missing initial LZW clear dictionary, discard final JPEG restart markers only immediately before EOI after the MCU count, crop excess CCITT columns by encoded row stride, retry syntax failures with conflicting valid predictor precision at the image precision only if decoding succeeds, and discard inconsistent JPX tile-part counts while retaining ordered parts and exact lengths. Strict mode rejects each repair. JPEG recovery follows T.81 B.2.1 and B.2.4.4; JPX follows T.800 A.4.2. A sole misplaced JPX mapping box preceding the codestream supplies the header palette mapping, reported under T.800 I.5.3.4-I.5.3.5. Mislabeled DCT data is recovered as Flate only with matching predictor metadata, strict framing/checksum validation and exact sample length.

Empty inline filter arrays are empty chains. Device colour spaces may be expressed as a one-name array, including on image XObjects. An image Subtype permits a reported repair of an invalid optional XObject Type.

An otherwise complete content sequence with unmatched saved graphics states reports their closure at sequence end. Unfinished operands, paths, text, marked content and compatibility sections still fail.

Inconsistent d0/d1 horizontal or vertical metrics are reported while Widths retains the horizontal advance; strict mode rejects the mismatch. As a compatibility repair, reversed d1 bounds are ignored only after the entire procedure compiles without drawing commands. Strict validation, painted glyphs, procedure syntax and work limits remain enforced.

Coloured patterns paint in their intrinsic colours and accept only their name even if the Pattern colour space declares a base. A reported repair discards extra numeric operands of the selected underlying colour space; wrong types and counts remain syntax errors. The underlying space is retained for later uncoloured patterns.

Reported viewing policy: complete auxiliary/refinement regions override contradicting page capability bits 5/1. Strict mode rejects the deviation. Actual segment syntax, referrals, combination operators, complete decoding, and all resource bounds remain authoritative. Expected bitmaps are geometric and encoded independently of product code.

Reported viewing policy: a raw T.800 codestream may use an explicit PDF colour space with SMaskInData zero. Strict mode still requires full JPX framing. No colour or opacity metadata is inferred. Dimensions, channel count, precision, geometry, syntax and resource limits remain authoritative. Explicit PDF RGB remains RGB even when component sampling ratios resemble chroma subsampling; T.800 A.5.1/B.2 supply reference-grid sample placement, not a replacement colour-space declaration.

Unmatched Q and ET leave state unchanged only under reported Repair permission. Unfinished operands, text objects, paths and compatibility sections, unknown operators, crossed state boundaries and resource limits still fail.

Reported viewing policy: only Huffman symbol dictionaries with SDREFAGG=0 may retain the otherwise invalid, unused bit7 aggregation-table selector. Strict rejects it. Its raw selector still selects and validates a referenced custom table, including OOB eligibility, exact table counts and ordinary referral rules; parse, retained storage and work remain charged. Genuine aggregation and all other flag restrictions are unchanged. The first occurrence per diagnostics sink is reported in decode order (Globals before page); reuse coalesces the tag and preserves its first source location. Independent literal matrices cover main/Globals, repeated dictionaries, grayscale/stencils, genuine aggregation and malformed/limited controls.

requirements.status: Reported no-op for unmatched EMC; Strict rejects
requirements.rule: An EMC with no open marked-content sequence in the current content scope is malformed. Repair reports content.marked-unmatched and retains visibility, graphics/text/path/clip state and device structure without inventing a matching begin or sending a device End. Strict rejects. A form cannot consume caller marked content. Every operator is still metered; later incomplete state, unknown operators, required resources, cycles and limits remain errors.

requirements.status: Explicit reported repair policy; execution qualification pending
requirements.rule: Strict rejects nonzero high padding above a JP2 palette column precision. Repair clears only those unused bits, retaining every declared low-order bit, precision and signed-offset interpretation, and reports the first affected position. Meaningful 8/16-bit high bits, complete table/codestream validation, mapping rules, opacity refusals and all limits remain authoritative. PDF Indexed uses its own lookup and the original codestream index precision; stored palette octets do not imply a wider precision.
requirements.gaps: No inferred palette precision, incomplete-table/codestream recovery, or new Indexed container-palette opacity support. Public-page credit, full-source exact-head native/WASM, performance/memory and integration qualification remain pending.
